items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: For my first job, I left here with Johnny Le Long and his playmates. On the Lyric Theater.

ctx.x: He was my favorite drummer. Well, after a while, I played around with a couple of bands, like, well, like Kid Howard. I played with Kid. And I was still a youngster. And I had an opportunity to leave home, to go on the road with a show. For my first job, I left here with Johnny Le Long and his playmates. On the Lyric Theater.
